chars.WIFE: a Moroccan woman in her mid-twenties, wearing a mustard-yellow hijab and a long dark-green abaya with a small gold brooch
chars.HUSBAND: a Moroccan man around thirty, short black hair and trimmed beard, wearing a burgundy hoodie and light-grey jeans

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Seen from the bedroom doorway, the WIFE is hurriedly packing clothes into a small travel suitcase on the bed, glancing nervously over her shoulder, head-to-waist framing, face clearly visible. Modern Moroccan apartment bedroom, warm evening lamp light. 2D animated storybook illustration, no text.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: In a Moroccan living room with a low sedari sofa, the HUSBAND offers with open hands to come along, the WIFE shakes her head firmly and steps back refusing. Both faces visible, tension. 2D animated illustration, no text.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: The HUSBAND sits on the sedari sofa in the foreground, frowning suspiciously, watching the WIFE in the background who is typing secretly on her phone, smiling to herself. Evening, Moroccan living room. 2D animated illustration, no text.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: The WIFE sits on the edge of the bed holding her forehead, pretending to feel ill and pleading, while the HUSBAND stands near the door with crossed arms, doubtful. Moroccan bedroom. 2D animated illustration, no text.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: The HUSBAND standing in the apartment hallway, shrugging with both palms up, resigned but suspicious expression, a packed suitcase standing next to the front door. 2D animated illustration, no text.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Outside a modern Moroccan train station with arches and palm trees in daylight, the HUSBAND carries the small suitcase while the WIFE walks quickly ahead toward the entrance, not looking back. 2D animated illustration, no signs or text.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Inside a parked car, view over the HUSBAND's shoulder and side profile, he grips the steering wheel and stares intently through the windshield at a distant train station entrance across a parking lot. 2D animated illustration, no text.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: The WIFE with her small suitcase sneaking out of the train station entrance and climbing quickly into a red Moroccan petit taxi, glancing around guiltily, face visible, seen from across the street. 2D animated illustration, no text, no license plates.
